title: Triangulated compatibility of the evaluation-defined scalar Hom comparison
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme, let $A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings, and use constant ring sheaves on the small etale site and the ordinary unbounded module derived categories $D(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $D(X_{\mathrm{et}},B)$. Write $F(T)=T\otimes_A^L B$, $H_A(K,M)=R\mathcal Hom_A(K,M)$, and similarly $H_B$. Define $v_{K,M}:FH_A(K,M)\to H_B(FK,FM)$ as the tensor–Hom transpose of $FH_A(K,M)\otimes_B^L FK\cong F(H_A(K,M)\otimes_A^L K)\xrightarrow{F\mathrm{ev}_A}FM$. For each fixed $M$, this is a natural transformation between contravariant exact functors of $K$, compatible with their canonical shift identifications: it gives a morphism of the reversed distinguished triangles for every distinguished triangle of $K$'s, including its connecting morphism and signs. Its isomorphism locus is a thick subcategory: it contains zero and is closed under isomorphisms, shifts, cones, and direct summands. No flatness assumption on $B$ is imposed.

Notation and categorical conventions are those of [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], [def-weil-triangulated-category].

proof.text: Use the unique canonical tensor comparison of [lem-coef-etale-tensor-model-comparison]. Define the Hom comparison by transposing F of evaluation after that comparison. Naturality of the parametrized tensor-Hom adjunction counit and binary tensor comparison proves naturality in both K and M, by injectivity of the Hom bijection.

Apply [lem-coef-etale-hom-transpose-exact] to the constructed transformation and its evaluation equation. This supplies the normalized reversed exactness structures and compatibility with their shifts.

An exact functor preserves zero, hence its comparison is invertible at zero. Naturality conjugates components along isomorphisms. The shift square conjugates shifted components by the invertible shift comparisons. Apply the triangle two-out-of-three theorem to the induced morphism of distinguished triangles. Finally a retract diagram of objects yields a retract diagram of the corresponding arrows; an arrow retract of an isomorphism is invertible. These are all five clauses of the stated thick isomorphism locus.

reviewed_lean.note: EtaleHomShiftNormalization's factor n.negOnePow pins s_n = eps(n)(-1)^{nj}. The CommShift addition rule needs eps(a+b) = (-1)^{ab} eps(a) eps(b), which fails at a=b=1 and against the zero rule at (1,-1). So no sA exists and the main theorem was false for nonempty X. The cone test on Z -3-> Z shows eps(1) = -1 is right. Fixed by ((n*(n+1))/2).negOnePow, which is Mathlib's Cochain.leftShift sign at -n and gives the node's (-1)^a at n=-1. Docstrings, record note and report updated; the statement is unchanged. Also checked: canonical mu from exists-unique, transpose fixes v, both shift composites match Mathlib's comp/op formulas, all 5 thick-locus conditions, no flatness, internal-Hom dependency record restored, docstrings complete, only the two node-owned theorems use sorry. nt_compile: delivered file 22.1 s clean, fixed file 17.4 s clean.
